knownLimitations: The exact v71 RC3 integrated Lab APK B8918144 passed its artifact audit and three normal cold starts retained RC3 with Xms512/Xmx1536 auto, but manual VR interaction, balanced performance, and two new 90-minute soaks remain pending; the older 90-minute capture is supporting evidence only and does not accept this APK.
v71 Lab RC2 passed startup and Vulkan/OpenXR stereo runtime smoke, but still requires both-eye bow, B-close, controller, balanced performance, cold-start, remote-server and soak gates.
v71 Lab RC1 is runtime-smoke-passed only; manual headset interaction, balanced FPS, three cold starts, remote Tailscale and 30-minute soak gates remain pending.
Paired Strike works on the integrated server, but a remote Fabric 26.2 server must run the exact matching universal Vivecraft JAR before the feature negotiates; old or Vanilla peers fail closed.
The accepted Wrist path intentionally retains its known visible cost of about four FPS; v71 restores correctness rather than claiming a new Wrist performance improvement.
Intermittent VrApi Stale values between zero and display refresh remain a frame-pacing acceptance blocker.
32 of 36 root native ELF files use 4 KiB LOAD alignment; ZIP alignment alone is 16 KiB compliant.
The Sodium 0.9.1 comparison exhausted the Dynamic-refresh match gate and produced no eligible win; 0.9.2-alpha.4 remains the conservative retained version.

The exact v69 Stable APK passed Host gates and was installed with the expected signer and matching pulled base.apk hash, but its activity did not start after installation; post-install Stable runtime, cold-start, eye, controller and soak checks remain unclaimed.

The user's manual functional acceptance and the Camera Park performance/soak evidence belong to the exact Lab payload with Camera Park ON; they approved Stable promotion but are not a post-install Stable-package runtime claim.
Launcher Idle Throttle was not accepted and is omitted from v69 Stable; unattended autoplay remains restricted to the Lab package.

The v66 corrective candidate passed Host, packaging, APK-verification, same-signer installation, exact profile reconciliation, and unattended Vulkan/OpenXR world-start gates; supervised Wrist and Right-B interaction remain pending.
The historical v67 dev.1 through dev.4 artifacts are Host-only; the v67 APK embeds rc2.6, while the later user-accepted rc2.7 was a separate hot-deployed JAR.
The locked stack includes Xaero Minimap only; full Xaero World Map requires a separate optional mod and is not claimed by this build.

v66 optional integrations expose compatible key mappings and native container screens; it does not embed the Xaero minimap texture in the wrist and has no dedicated JEI or Inventory Profiles Next adapter.

v69Retest.invalidReason: A stale Lab rollback shell left tr consuming about 91 percent of one CPU core after the v1 OFF capture and throughout both ON captures.

cleanRetest.reason: Both comparable pairs failed the P10 guardrail; pair 2 also failed FPS and regressed P95 and stale delivery. A third pair cannot repair the required per-pair guardrail.

openXrPerFrameTelemetry.reason: Exact-refresh matched stale delivery was 9.6 percent worse and frame-time P95 did not improve.

openXrRendererThreadSettings.reason: Exact-refresh matched stale delivery was 5.7 percent worse, normalized FPS did not improve, and the 0.6 percent CPU plus GPU P95 gain was below the 2 percent gate. Hotter non-randomized runs are a confound, so the extension remains an isolated canary rather than an accepted optimization.
